bearing.model.v1alpha1.Entity.schema.jso.description: Entity is what the observation says about the observed entity itself.

^(linkedIds)$.description:
Keys in linked namespaces that the source records for the entity.
 Identity evidence, never aliases. When present, complete for the source.

aliases.description: More keys for the entity, in the source's own or issued namespaces.

attributes.description:
Attribute claims: a value, a list (the complete set) or null (none).
 Omitting an attribute means "not read".

deleted.description: The entity no longer exists in the source.

linked_ids.description:
Keys in linked namespaces that the source records for the entity.
 Identity evidence, never aliases. When present, complete for the source.
